	Public Sub SetFormat( docTarget As NotesDocument, lngLoop As Long )
		Dim varFNameList As Variant
		Dim varExistItem As Variant
		Dim varItem As Variant
		Dim strPiece As String
		Dim strReplace As String
		Dim strCustomize As String
		Dim strData As String
		Dim intCnt As Integer
		varFNameList = Split( Me.FName, ";" )
		Forall tmpFName In varFNameList
			strCustomize = ""
			strReplace = ""
			Set varExistItem = docTarget.GetFirstItem( tmpFName )
			If varExistItem Is Nothing Then
			Else
				Select Case varExistItem.Type
				Case 1
					Call Me.DeleteAttachFile( varExistItem )
				Case Else
				End Select
				Call varExistItem.Remove
			End If
			If Me.setChangeInfo = "%" Then
				Call docTarget.ReplaceItemValue( tmpFName, lngLoop )
			Else
				For intCnt = 1 To Len( Me.SetChangeInfo )
					strPiece = Mid( Me.SetChangeInfo, intCnt, 1 )
					strReplace = strReplace & strPiece
					If Left( strReplace, 1 ) = "[" Then
						If strPiece = "]" Then
							If strReplace = "[%]" Then
								strCustomize = strCustomize & Cstr(lngLoop)
							Elseif strReplace = "[" & Ustring(Len(strReplace)-2, "*") & "]" Then
								strCustomize = strCustomize & Right( Ustring(Len(strReplace)-2, "0") & Cstr( lngLoop ), Len( strReplace)-2 )
							Else
								Set varItem = docTarget.GetFirstItem( Mid( strReplace, 2, Len(strReplace)-2 ) )
								If varItem Is Nothing Then
									strData = ""
								Else
									If varItem.Type = 1 Then
										strData = varItem.UnformattedText( )
									Else
										strData = varItem.Text
									End If
								End If
								strCustomize = strCustomize & strData
								strData = ""
							End If
							strReplace = ""
						Else
						End If
					Else
						strCustomize = strCustomize & strReplace
						strReplace = ""
					End If
				Next
				strCustomize = strCustomize & strReplace
				Call docTarget.ReplaceItemValue( tmpFName, strCustomize )
			End If
		End Forall
	End Sub

Sub Initialize

	Dim objInputInfo As clsInputInfo
	Dim strSearchMacro As String
	Dim intReturn As Integer
	Dim blnSelectFlg As Boolean
	Dim blnLoopFlg As Boolean
	Do

		intReturn = fncDataPreparation( strSearchMacro, _
		objBaseDBInfo, objDocElement, objInputInfo )
		Select Case intReturn
		Case 0
			strSearchMacro = ""
		Case Else
			Exit Sub
		End Select
		Do
			blnLoopFlg = False
			intReturn = fncMain( objBaseDBInfo, objDocElement, objInputInfo )
			Select Case intReturn
			Case 0
				blnLoopFlg = objInputInfo.RepetitionFlg
			Case 1
				If objInputInfo.RepetitionFlg = False Then
					Exit Sub
				Elseif Msgbox( "連続入力を終了しますか？", 4+32+256, "連続入力確認" ) = 7 Then
					blnLoopFlg = True
				Else
					Exit Sub

				blnSelectFlg = True
				strSearchMacro = objInputInfo.InputValue
			Case 4
				blnLoopFlg = True
			Case Else
				Exit Sub
			End Select
			Call objInputInfo.InitialSet( )
		Loop While blnLoopFlg = True
	Loop While blnSelectFlg = True
	Exit Sub

	Exit Sub

Function fncDataPreparation( strSearchMacro As String, _
objBaseDBInfo As clsBaseDBInfo, objDocElement As clsDocElement, _
objInputInfo As clsInputInfo ) As Integer
	On Error Goto ERR_HANDLE
	fncDataPreparation = -1
	Dim strTitle As String
	Dim strMsg As String
	Dim intReturn As Integer
	Dim lngSelectCnt As Long
	If objBaseDBInfo Is Nothing Then
		Set objBaseDBInfo = New clsBaseDBInfo
		Select Case objBaseDBInfo.ACLLevel
		Case ACLLEVEL_MANAGER
		Case ACLLEVEL_EDITOR , ACLLEVEL_DESIGNER
			If  Isnull(Arraygetindex(objBaseDBInfo.UserRoles, "[DATACHANGE]", 1) ) = False Then
			Else
				Msgbox "使用する権限がありません。" , 16 , "使用不可"
				fncDataPreparation = 1
				Exit Function
			End If
		Case Else
			Msgbox "使用する権限がありません。" , 16 , "使用不可"
			fncDataPreparation = 1
			Exit Function
		End Select
	End If
	With objBaseDBInfo
		Call  .GetSelectDoc( strSearchMacro )
		lngSelectCnt =  .SelectDocCnt
	End With
	If strSearchMacro = "" Then
		Select Case lngSelectCnt
		Case 0
			Msgbox "文書を選択してから実行してください。" , 48 , "対象文書未選択"
			fncDataPreparation = 1
			Exit Function
		Case 1
		Case Else
			If Msgbox( "現在、" & Cstr( lngSelectCnt ) & "件の文書を選択しています･･･" & Chr(13)_
			& "処理を続行してもよろしいですか？", 4+32, "変更件数確認" ) = 7 Then
				Msgbox "データ変更を取りやめました。" , 48 , "変更中止"
				fncDataPreparation = 1
				Exit Function
			End If
		End Select
	Else
		Select Case lngSelectCnt
		Case 0
			Call objBaseDBInfo.GetSelectDoc( "" )
			lngSelectCnt = objBaseDBInfo.SelectDocCnt
			Msgbox "条件に該当する文書が見つかりませんでした。" & Chr(13) _
			& "代わりに選択文書" & Cstr( lngSelectCnt ) & "件を処理対象にします。" , 48 , "対象文書なし"
		Case Else
			Msgbox Cstr( lngSelectCnt ) & "件の文書が見つかりました。" & Chr(13) _
			& "抽出した文書を処理対象にします。" , 64 , "対象文書抽出"
		End Select
	End If
	Call objBaseDBInfo.GetFirstDoc( )
	If objDocElement Is Nothing Then
	Else
		Delete objDocElement
	End If
	Set objDocElement = New clsDocElement( objBaseDBInfo.FirstDoc )
	Call objDocElement.GetFList( )
	If objInputInfo Is Nothing Then
		Set objInputInfo = New clsInputInfo
	Else
	End If

	strMsg = {データ変更を行うフィールド名を入力してください。} & Chr(13) _
	& {また、特殊操作のヘルプを参照する場合は「?」を入力してください。}
	Call objInputInfo.FNameInfo( strTitle, strMsg, "", objDocElement.listFName )
	fncDataPreparation = 0
	Exit Function
ERR_HANDLE:
	Call OnErrorMsgDisp( "fncDataPreparation関数", Erl, Err, Error$ )
	fncDataPreparation = -1
	Exit Function
End Function

Function fncSelectAct( objInputInfo As clsInputInfo ) As Integer

	Do

		intReturn = objInputInfo.fncPromptSet( 1 )

		Else
			strFName = Strconv( objInputInfo.FName, 8 )
		End If

			blnInputFlg = True
			Msgbox "連続入力可能に設定しました。", 64, "連続入力"
		Case "%"
			objInputInfo.LogFlg = True
			blnInputFlg = True
			Msgbox "ログ書出し設定にしました。", 64, "ログ設定"
		Case "/"
			objInputInfo.AllSetFlg = True
			blnInputFlg = True
			Msgbox "一括処理可能に設定しました。", 64, "一括処理設定"
		Case "@"
			If objInputInfo.AllSetFlg = True Then
				blnInputFlg = True
				Msgbox "一括処理を設定した場合、" & Chr(13)_
				& "式の実行はできません。", 48, "INPUT ERROR"
			Else
			End If
		Case "!A"
			If Msgbox( "文書を増殖します。" & Chr(13) & "よろしいですか？", 4+32+256, "入力確認" ) = 7 Then
				blnInputFlg = True
				Msgbox "再度入力してください。", 64, "入力確認"
			Else
			End If
		Case "!C"
			If Msgbox( "文書をコピーします。" & Chr(13) & "よろしいですか？", 4+32+256, "入力確認" ) = 7 Then
				blnInputFlg = True
				Msgbox "再度入力してください。", 64, "入力確認"
			Else
			End If
		Case "!D"
			If Msgbox( "文書を削除します。" & Chr(13) & "よろしいですか？", 4+32+256, "入力確認" ) = 7 Then
				blnInputFlg = True
				Msgbox "再度入力してください。", 64, "入力確認"
			Else
			End If
		Case "!M"
			If Msgbox( "文書を移動します。" & Chr(13) & "よろしいですか？", 4+32+256, "入力確認" ) = 7 Then
				blnInputFlg = True
				Msgbox "再度入力してください。", 64, "入力確認"
			Else
			End If
		Case "!R"
			If objInputInfo.AllSetFlg = True Then
				blnInputFlg = True
				Msgbox "一括処理を設定した場合、" & Chr(13)_
				& "文書の更新はできません。", 48, "INPUT ERROR"
			Elseif Msgbox( "文書を更新します。" & Chr(13) & "よろしいですか？", 4+32+256, "入力確認" ) = 7 Then
				blnInputFlg = True
				Msgbox "再度入力してください。", 64, "入力確認"
			Else
			End If
		Case "?"
			blnInputFlg = True
			Msgbox SelectReturnString("FIELDNAME_HELP_MESSAGE"), 64, "特殊操作ヘルプ"
		Case Else
			If Left( strFName, 1 ) = ";" Then
				blnInputFlg = True
				Msgbox "はじめにセミコロンは入力できません。", 48, "INPUT ERROR"
			Elseif Right( strFName, 1 ) = ";" Then
				blnInputFlg = True
				Msgbox "最後にセミコロンは入力できません。", 48, "INPUT ERROR"
			Elseif Instr( 1, strFName, ";;", 0 ) > 0 Then
				blnInputFlg = True
				Msgbox "連続したセミコロンは入力できません。", 48, "INPUT ERROR"
			Elseif ( objInputInfo.AllSetFlg = True ) And ( Instr( 1, strFName, ";", 0 ) > 0 ) Then
				blnInputFlg = True
				Msgbox "一括処理を設定した場合、" & Chr(13)_
				& "複数フィールドに対して処理できません。", 48, "INPUT ERROR"
			Else
			End If
		End Select
	Loop While blnInputFlg = True
	fncSelectAct = 0
	Exit Function
ERR_HANDLE:
	Call OnErrorMsgDisp( "fncSelectAct関数", Erl, Err, Error$ )
	fncSelectAct = -1
	Exit Function
End Function
Function fncExistDataDecision( objDocElement As clsDocElement, _
objInputInfo As clsInputInfo ) As Integer
	On Error Goto ERR_HANDLE
	fncExistDataDecision = -1
	Dim varSetDefault As Variant
	Dim varSetSubDefault As Variant
	Dim varSetTypeDefault As Variant
	Dim varFName As Variant
	Dim strFName As String
	Dim strTitle As String
	Dim strMsg As String
	Dim strData As String
	Dim strDefault As String
	Dim strSubDefault As String
	Dim strSelectMain As String
	Dim strTmp As String
	Dim strSubType As String
	Dim strType As String
	Dim strTypeElement As String
	strFName = Strconv(objInputInfo.FName, 8)
	Select Case strFName
	Case "@", "!A", "!C", "!D", "!M", "!R", "*"
		fncExistDataDecision = 0
		Exit Function
	Case Else
	End Select
	varFName = Split( objInputInfo.FName, ";" )
	If Ubound(varFName) > 0 Then
		Call MakeMsg(objDocElement, varFName)
		Call objInputInfo.SetOldProperty( "", "" )
		strTitle = "☆フィールド名：『" & objInputInfo.FName & "』"
		strMsg = SelectReturnString( "REPLACE_FIELD_MESSAGE" )
		strDefault = "S"
		strSelectMain = "S/D/N/V/R/E/S[N]/S[NR]/S[NA]/Z"
		strSubDefault =  "V-D"
	Else
		Call objDocElement.GetFInfo( objInputInfo.FName, 0 )
		If objDocElement.FValue Is Nothing Then
			Msgbox "フィールドが存在しません。" & Chr(13) & "データを新規作成します。" , 64 , "データ作成"
			strTitle = "☆フィールド名：『" & objInputInfo.FName & "』"
			strMsg = SelectReturnString( "NEW_FIELD_MESSAGE" )
			strDefault = "S"
			If objInputInfo.AllSetFlg = False Then
				strSelectMain = "S/D/N/V/R/S[N]/S[NR]/S[NA]/Z"
			Else
				strSelectMain = "S/D/N/V/Z"
			End If
			strSubDefault =  "V-D"
		Else
			With objDocElement
				Call  .GetFInfo( objInputInfo.FName, 1 )
				strDefault = fncExistType(  .FProperty,  .FValue )
			End With
			strType = fncSeparateProperty( strDefault, 0 )
			strTypeElement = fncSeparateProperty( strDefault, 1 )
			If objInputInfo.AllSetFlg = False Then
			Else
				Select Case strDefault
				Case "S", "D", "N", "V", "V-D"
				Case Else
					fncExistDataDecision = 2
					Msgbox SelectReturnString("ALLSET_ERROR_MESSAGE"), 48 , "一括処理不可"
					Exit Function
				End Select
			End If
			Select Case strType
			Case "R", "V-R"
				If objDocElement.AttachList( 0 ) <> "" Then
					Forall tmpFile In objDocElement.AttachList
						strTmp = strTmp & "       ⇒" & tmpFile & Chr(13)
					End Forall
					Msgbox "指定したフィールドに以下のファイルが保存されています。" & Chr(13)&Chr(13)_
					& strTmp & Chr(13) & SelectReturnString( "FILE_CHECK_MESSAGE" ), 64, "ファイルの確認"
				End If
			Case Else
			End Select
			If strType = "R" Then
				strData = objDocElement.FValue.GetUnFormattedText()
			Else
				strData = objDocElement.FValue.text
			End If
			Call objInputInfo.SetOldProperty( strDefault, strData )
			If Len(strData) > 50 Then
				strTmp = Left(strData, 50) & "･･･"
			Else
				strTmp = strData
			End If
			strTitle = "☆フィールド名：『" & objInputInfo.FName & "』    ★値：『" & strTmp & "』"
			strMsg = SelectReturnString("REPLACE_FIELD_MESSAGE")
			If objInputInfo.AllSetFlg = False Then
				strSelectMain = "S/D/N/V/R/E/S[N]/S[NR]/S[NA]"
				If strType = "S" Then
					strSelectMain = strSelectMain & "/U/A/C"
				Elseif strType = "R" Then
					strSelectMain = strSelectMain & "/A"
				Else
				End If
				strSelectMain = strSelectMain & "/Z/" & strDefault
				Select Case strType
				Case "S","D","N","V","R"
					strSubDefault =  "V-D"
				Case Else
					strSubDefault = strDefault
				End Select
			Else
				strSelectMain = "S/D/N/V/Z/" & strDefault
				strSubDefault =  "V-D"
			End If
		End If
	End If
	varSetDefault = KeywordListReturn( strDefault )
	Call objInputInfo.MainInfo( strTitle, strMsg, varSetDefault(0), KeywordListReturn( strSelectMain ) )
	strMsg = SelectReturnString("SPECIAL_ELEMENT_MESSAGE")
	If objInputInfo.AllSetFlg = False Then
		strSelectMain = "V-D/V-R/S[NRA]/V[NRA]/V[N]/V[NR]/V[NA]/F"
	Else
		strSelectMain = "V-D"
	End If
	varSetSubDefault = KeywordListReturn( strSubDefault )
	Call objInputInfo.SpecialInfo( strTitle, strMsg, varSetSubDefault(0), KeywordListReturn( strSelectMain ) )
	If strTypeElement <> "" Then
		varSetTypeDefault = KeywordListReturn("[" & strTypeElement & "]")
	Else
		varSetTypeDefault = KeywordListReturn("S")
	End If
	strTitle = "◆設定する型･･･【属性変更】  ☆フィールド名：『" & objInputInfo.FName & "』"
	strMsg = "設定する型を選択してください。"
	Call objInputInfo.ElementInfo( strTitle, strMsg, varSetTypeDefault(0), KeywordListReturn( "S/[N]/[NR]/[NA]/[NRA]" ) )
	fncExistDataDecision = 0
	Exit Function
ERR_HANDLE:
	Call OnErrorMsgDisp( "fncExistDataDecision関数", Erl, Err, Error$ )
	fncExistDataDecision = -1
	Exit Function
End Function

Function fncSetDataInput( objInputInfo As clsInputInfo, _
objDataSetPreparation As clsDataSetPreparation ) As Integer
	On Error Goto ERR_HANDLE
	Dim vInputEndFlag As Variant
	Dim varResult As Variant
	Dim strData As String
	Dim strType As String
	Dim intInputSize As Integer
	Dim intCustomFlg As Integer
	Dim intReturn As Integer
	fncSetDataInput = -1
	strType = fncSeparateProperty( objInputInfo.FProperty, 0 )
	Select Case strType
	Case "S","N","D","R","U","A","F","@","*","!A","!C","!M"
		Do
			vInputEndFlag = True
			intReturn = objInputInfo.fncPromptSet(4)
			If intReturn < 1 Then
				fncSetDataInput = 1
				Msgbox "データ変更を取りやめました。" , 48 , "変更中止"
				Exit Function
			Else
			End If
			strData = objInputInfo.InputValue
			intInputSize = InputDataByteCheck(strData)
			If intInputSize > 253 Then
				Msgbox SelectReturnString("INPUT_SIZE_ERROR_MESSAGE")_
				& "『" & strData & "』", 16, "INPUT ERROR"
				objInputInfo.InputInfoDefault = strData
				vInputEndFlag = False
			Elseif fncInputCheck( strType, strData ) = False Then
				Msgbox SelectReturnString("INPUT_ERROR_MESSAGE"), 16, "INPUT ERROR"
				objInputInfo.InputInfoDefault = strData
				vInputEndFlag = False
			Else
				If strType = "*" Then
					fncSetDataInput = 2
					Exit Function
				Else
					intCustomFlg = fncInputDataCustomize( objInputInfo, objDataSetPreparation )
					Select Case intCustomFlg
					Case 0
					Case 1
						vInputEndFlag = False
						objInputInfo.InputInfoDefault = strData
					Case Else
						fncSetDataInput = -1
						Exit Function
					End Select
				End If
			End If
		Loop While vInputEndFlag = False
	Case Else
		intCustomFlg = fncInputDataCustomize( objInputInfo, objDataSetPreparation )
		Select Case intCustomFlg
		Case 0
		Case 1
			fncSetDataInput = 1
			Exit Function
		Case Else
			fncSetDataInput = -1
			Exit Function
		End Select
	End Select
	fncSetDataInput = 0
	Exit Function
ERR_HANDLE:
	Call OnErrorMsgDisp( "fncSetDataInput関数", Erl, Err, Error$ )
	fncSetDataInput = -1
	Exit Function
End Function
Function fncInputDataCustomize( objInputInfo As clsInputInfo, _
objDataSetPreparation As clsDataSetPreparation ) As Integer
	On Error Goto ERR_HANDLE
	Dim dbCopy As NotesDatabase
	Dim varResult As Variant
	Dim varRet As Variant
	Dim strData As String
	Dim strType As String
	Dim strElement As String
	Dim blnRichSet As Boolean
	fncInputDataCustomize = -1
	strData = objInputInfo.InputValue
	strType = fncSeparateProperty( objInputInfo.FProperty, 0 )
	strElement = fncSeparateProperty( objInputInfo.FProperty, 1 )
	Set objDataSetPreparation = New clsDataSetPreparation
	Select Case strType
	Case "!A"
		Call objDataSetPreparation.GetCopyDB( ";" )
	Case "!C","!M"
		Call objDataSetPreparation.GetCopyDB( objInputInfo.InputValue )
		Set dbCopy = objDataSetPreparation.CopyDB
		If dbCopy Is Nothing Then
			Msgbox "指定のDBが取得できません。", 48 , "DB取得エラー"
			fncInputDataCustomize = 1
			Exit Function
			Elseif Msgbox( "文書反映先は以下のDBでよろしいですか？" & Chr(13)&Chr(13) _
			& "タイトル：" & dbCopy.Title & Chr(13) & _
			"サーバ名：" & dbCopy.Server & Chr(13) & _
		"ファイルパス：" & dbCopy.FilePath, 4+32+256, "反映先確認" ) = 7 Then
			fncInputDataCustomize = 1
			Exit Function
		Elseif Not dbCopy.CurrentAccessLevel = ACLLEVEL_MANAGER Then
			Msgbox "コピー先DBに管理者の権限がないため、" & Chr(13) _
			& "文書を反映できません。" , 16 , "権限不足"
			fncInputDataCustomize = 1
			Exit Function
		Else
		End If
	Case Else
	End Select
	Select Case strType
	Case "!D","!M"
		varRet = Evaluate( {@UserAccess( @DbName ; [DELETEDOCUMENTS] )} )
		If ( varRet(0) <> "1" ) Then
			Msgbox "文書を削除する権限がありません。" , 16 , "権限不足"
			fncInputDataCustomize = 1
			Exit Function
		Else
		End If
	Case Else
	End Select
	Select Case strType
	Case "!A"
		If Msgbox( "対象文書を" & Cstr(Clng(objInputInfo.InputValue)) _
		& "倍にして追加しますがよろしいですか？", 4+32+256, "倍数確認" ) = 7 Then
			fncInputDataCustomize = 1
			Exit Function
		Else
		End If
	Case Else
	End Select
	Select Case strType
	Case "S","V"
		If strElement = "" Then
			Call LineTabChange( 1, strData )
		Else
		End If
		varResult = fncArrayCreaData( 0, strData )
		Call objDataSetPreparation.SetInputData( varResult, strElement )
	Case "N"
		varResult = fncArrayCreaData( 1, strData )
		Call objDataSetPreparation.SetInputData( varResult, "" )
	Case "D","V-D"
		varResult = fncArrayCreaData( 2, strData )
		Call objDataSetPreparation.SetInputData( varResult, "" )
	Case "R","V-R"
		Call LineTabChange( 1, strData )
		Call objDataSetPreparation.CreateRichData( varResult )
		If RichReplace( strData, varResult ) = False Then
			fncInputDataCustomize = 1
			Exit Function
		Else
		End If
	Case "U","F"
		Call LineTabChange( 1, strData )
	Case "A"
		Call LineTabChange( 1, strData )
		If fncSeparateProperty( objInputInfo.FOldProperty, 0 ) = "R" Then
			Call objDataSetPreparation.CreateRichData( varResult )
			If RichReplace( strData, varResult ) = False Then
				fncInputDataCustomize = 1
				Exit Function
			Else
			End If
		Else
			varResult = fncArrayCreaData( 0, strData )
			Call objDataSetPreparation.SetInputData( varResult, "" )
		End If
	Case "!A"
		Call objDataSetPreparation.SetInputData( Clng(strData), "" )
	Case Else
		Call objDataSetPreparation.SetInputData( "", "" )
	End Select
	Select Case strType
	Case "@","!A","!C","!D","!M","!R"
		objDataSetPreparation.FName = ""
	Case Else
		objDataSetPreparation.FName = objInputInfo.FName
	End Select
	Select Case strType
	Case "E","U","F","@","!A","!C","!D","!M","!R"
		Call objDataSetPreparation.SetOperateType( strType, strData )
	Case "C"
		Call objDataSetPreparation.SetOperateType( strType, objInputInfo.ChangeProperty )
	Case Else
		Call objDataSetPreparation.SetOperateType( strType, strElement )
	End Select
	Select Case strType
	Case "@","!A","!C","!D","!M","!R"
		Call objDataSetPreparation.LogInfo( False, "" )
	Case Else
		Call objDataSetPreparation.LogInfo( objInputInfo.LogFlg, objInputInfo.LogPath )
	End Select
	objDataSetPreparation.AllSetFlg = objInputInfo.AllSetFlg
	fncInputDataCustomize = 0
	Exit Function
ERR_HANDLE:
	fncInputDataCustomize = -1
	Call OnErrorMsgDisp( "fncInputDataCustomize関数", Erl, Err, Error$ )
	Exit Function
End Function
Function fncInputDataReplace( objDataSetPreparation As clsDataSetPreparation, _
objBaseDBInfo As clsBaseDBInfo ) As Integer
	On Error Goto ERR_HANDLE
	Dim docTarget As NotesDocument
	Dim lngDcCnt As Long
	Dim lngLoop As Long
	Dim lngCopyCnt As Long
	Dim lngLargeCnt As Long
	Dim lngCopyLargeCnt As Long
	Dim lngSaveErrCnt As Long
	Dim lngSetErrCnt As Long
	Dim strType As String
	Dim intReturn As Integer
	Dim blnSetErrFlg As Boolean
	fncInputDataReplace = -1
	lngDcCnt = objBaseDBInfo.SelectDocCnt
	strType = objDataSetPreparation.SetTypeInfo
	If objDataSetPreparation.AllSetFlg = True Then
		Select Case strType
		Case "!A"
			For lngCopyCnt = 1 To objDataSetPreparation.CustomData.Values(0)
				Call objDataSetPreparation.AllDocCopyDel( 1, objBaseDBInfo.SelectDoc )
			Next
		Case "!C"
			Call objDataSetPreparation.AllDocCopyDel( 1, objBaseDBInfo.SelectDoc )
		Case "!D"
			Call objDataSetPreparation.AllDocCopyDel( 2, objBaseDBInfo.SelectDoc )
		Case "!M"
			Call objDataSetPreparation.AllDocCopyDel( 3, objBaseDBInfo.SelectDoc )
		Case Else
			Call objDataSetPreparation.AllDocChangeValue( objBaseDBInfo.SelectDoc )
		End Select
		lngSaveErrCnt = 0
		lngSetErrCnt = 0
	Else
		For lngLoop = 1 To lngDcCnt
			blnSetErrFlg = False
			Set docTarget = objBaseDBInfo.fncReturnDocNth( lngLoop )
			If ( lngLoop Mod 250 ) = 0 Then
				If ( lngLoop + 249 ) > lngDcCnt Then
					lngLargeCnt = lngDcCnt
				Else
					lngLargeCnt = lngLoop + 249
				End If
				Print Cstr( lngLoop ) & "～" & Cstr( lngLargeCnt ) & "件を処理中・・・"_
				& "全件数：" & Cstr( lngDcCnt ) & "件"
			Else
			End If
			If objDataSetPreparation.LogFlg = False Then
			Else
				intReturn = fncFieldDataLog( docTarget, Split( objDataSetPreparation.FName, ";" ) )
				If intReturn = 0 Then
				Else
					blnSetErrFlg = True
				End If
			End If
			Select Case strType
			Case "A"
				Call objDataSetPreparation.AddValue( docTarget )
			Case "F"
				Call objDataSetPreparation.SetFormat( docTarget, lngLoop )
			Case "@"
				intReturn = objDataSetPreparation.fncExecuteMacro( docTarget )
				If intReturn = 0 Then
				Else
					blnSetErrFlg = True
				End If
			Case "!A"
				lngCopyLargeCnt = 0
				For lngCopyCnt = 1 To objDataSetPreparation.CustomData.Values(0)
					If ( lngCopyCnt Mod 250 ) = 0 Then
						If ( lngCopyCnt + 249 ) > objDataSetPreparation.CustomData.Values(0) Then
							lngCopyLargeCnt = objDataSetPreparation.CustomData.Values(0)
						Else
							lngCopyLargeCnt = lngCopyCnt + 249
						End If
						Print Cstr( lngLoop ) & "件目 ⇒ " & Cstr( lngCopyCnt ) & "～" & Cstr( lngCopyLargeCnt ) & "件を増殖中・・・"_
						& "増殖件数：" & Cstr( objDataSetPreparation.CustomData.Values(0) ) & "件"
					Else
					End If
					intReturn = objDataSetPreparation.fncDocCopyDel( 1, docTarget )
					If intReturn = 0 Then
					Else
						lngSaveErrCnt = lngSaveErrCnt + 1
						Exit For
					End If
				Next
			Case "!C"
				intReturn = objDataSetPreparation.fncDocCopyDel( 1, docTarget )
				If intReturn = 0 Then
				Else
					lngSaveErrCnt = lngSaveErrCnt + 1
				End If
			Case "!D"
				intReturn = objDataSetPreparation.fncDocCopyDel( 2, docTarget )
				If intReturn = 0 Then
				Else
					lngSaveErrCnt = lngSaveErrCnt + 1
				End If
			Case "!M"
				intReturn = objDataSetPreparation.fncDocCopyDel( 3, docTarget )
				If intReturn = 0 Then
				Else
					lngSaveErrCnt = lngSaveErrCnt + 1
				End If
			Case "!R"
				If docTarget.ComputeWithForm( False, False ) = False Then
					blnSetErrFlg = True
				Else
				End If
			Case Else
				intReturn = objDataSetPreparation.ChangeValue( docTarget )
				If intReturn = 0 Then
				Else
					blnSetErrFlg = True
				End If
			End Select
			Select Case strType
			Case "!A","!C","!D","!M"
			Case Else
				If blnSetErrFlg = False Then
					If docTarget.Save( False, False ) = False Then
						lngSaveErrCnt = lngSaveErrCnt + 1
					End If
				Else
					lngSetErrCnt = lngSetErrCnt + 1
				End If
			End Select
		Next
	End If
	Call EndMsgDisp( strType, lngDcCnt, lngSaveErrCnt, lngSetErrCnt )
	Select Case strType
	Case "!D", "!M"
		fncInputDataReplace = 1
		Exit Function
	Case Else
	End Select
	fncInputDataReplace = 0
	Exit Function
ERR_HANDLE:
	fncInputDataReplace = -1
	Call OnErrorMsgDisp( "fncInputDataReplace関数", Erl, Err, Error$ )
	Exit Function
End Function

Function InputDataByteCheck( strData As String ) As Integer

Sub LineTabChange( intChangeType As Integer, strData As String )

	Dim strTmpKey As String

	Dim intSetCnt As Integer

	If intLength = 0 Then

Function RichReplace( strResult As String, varRText As Variant ) As Boolean
	Dim ss As NotesSession
	Dim rtsStyle As NotesRichTextStyle
	Dim strList List As String
	Dim strDat As String
	Dim strSubData As String
	Dim strCode As String
	Dim strEleData As String
	Dim intNum As Integer
	Dim strTmp As String
	Set ss = New NotesSession
	intNum = 1
	RichReplace = False
	strDat = Left( strResult, 1 )
	Set rtsStyle = ss.CreateRichTextStyle( )
	With rtsStyle
		.Bold = False
		.Effects = 0
		.FontSize = 10
		.Italic = False
		.NotesColor = 0
		.NotesFont = 1
		.StrikeThrough = False
		.UnderLine = False
	End With
	Call varRText.AppendStyle( rtsStyle )
	While strDat <> ""
		If strDat = "[" Then
			strCode = Strconv(Mid(strResult, intNum+1, 2), 1+8)
			If ( strCode = "F*" ) Or ( strCode = "E*" ) Then
				intNum = intNum + 3
				strDat = Mid(strResult, intNum, 1)
				Do While True
					Select Case strDat
					Case "","]"
						strList(intNum) = strEleData
						strEleData = ""
						Exit Do
					Case "/"
						strList(intNum) = strEleData
						strEleData = ""
					Case Else
						strEleData = strEleData & strDat
					End Select
					intNum = intNum + 1
					strDat = Mid(strResult, intNum, 1)
				Loop
				Select Case strCode
				Case "F*"
					On Error Goto ELEMENT_ERROR
					Forall tmpDat In strList
						strTmp = Strconv(tmpDat, 1+8)
						If strTmp = "B" Then
							rtsStyle.Bold = True
						Elseif strTmp Like "E:*" Then
							rtsStyle.Effects = Cint(Mid(strTmp, 3))
						Elseif strTmp = "I" Then
							rtsStyle.Italic = True
						Elseif strTmp Like "C:*" Then
							rtsStyle.NotesColor = Cint(Mid(strTmp, 3))
						Elseif strTmp Like "F:*" Then
							rtsStyle.NotesFont = Cint(Mid(strTmp, 3))
						Elseif strTmp = "T" Then
							rtsStyle.StrikeThrough = True
						Elseif strTmp = "U" Then
							rtsStyle.UnderLine = True
						Elseif strTmp Like "S:*" Then
							rtsStyle.FontSize = Cint(Mid(strTmp, 3))
						Else
							Msgbox "属性の設定で入力ミスがあります。" & Chr(13)_
							& "下記の文字列を確認してください。" & Chr(13)&Chr(13)_
							& "[" & strCode & "]の設定  ⇒  入力ミスの属性：『" & strTmp & "』", 16, "InputError"
							Exit Function
						End If
					End Forall
					On Error Goto 0
				Case "E*"
					Forall tmpDat In strList
						strTmp = Strconv(tmpDat, 1+8)
						Select Case strTmp
						Case "D"
							With rtsStyle
								.Bold = False
								.Effects = 0
								.FontSize = 10
								.Italic = False
								.NotesColor = 0
								.NotesFont = 1
								.StrikeThrough = False
								.UnderLine = False
							End With
						Case "B"
							rtsStyle.Bold = False
						Case "E"
							rtsStyle.Effects = 0
						Case "S"
							rtsStyle.FontSize = 10
						Case "I"
							rtsStyle.Italic = False
						Case "C"
							rtsStyle.NotesColor = 0
						Case "F"
							rtsStyle.NotesFont = 1
						Case "T"
							rtsStyle.StrikeThrough = False
						Case "U"
							rtsStyle.UnderLine = False
						Case Else
							Msgbox "属性の設定で入力ミスがあります。" & Chr(13)_
							& "下記の文字列を確認してください。" & Chr(13)&Chr(13)_
							& "[" & strCode & "]の設定  ⇒  入力ミスの属性：『" & strTmp & "』", 16, "InputError"
							Exit Function
						End Select
					End Forall
				Case Else
				End Select
				If strSubData <> "" Then
					Call varRText.AppendText( strSubData )
					strSubData = ""
				End If
				Call varRText.AppendStyle( rtsStyle )
				Erase strList
			Elseif Mid(strResult, intNum+1, 1) = "/" Then
				intNum = intNum + 2
				strDat = Mid(strResult, intNum, 1)
				Do While True
					Select Case strDat
					Case "","]"
						Exit Do
					Case "/"
						strList(intNum) = strEleData
						strEleData = ""
					Case Else
						strEleData = strEleData & strDat
					End Select
					intNum = intNum + 1
					strDat = Mid(strResult, intNum, 1)
				Loop
				If strSubData <> "" Then
					Call varRText.AppendText( strSubData )
					strSubData = ""
				End If
				Forall tmpPath In strList
					On Error 4225 Goto FILE_ERROR
					Call varRText.EmbedObject( EMBED_ATTACHMENT, "", tmpPath )
					On Error Goto 0
				End Forall
				strEleData = ""
				Erase strList
			Else
				Select Case strDat
				Case "~"
					strSubData = strSubData & Chr(13)&Chr(10)
				Case "|"
					strSubData = strSubData & Chr(9)
				Case Else
					strSubData = strSubData & strDat
				End Select
			End If
		Else
			Select Case strDat
			Case "~"
				strSubData = strSubData & Chr(13)&Chr(10)
			Case "|"
				strSubData = strSubData & Chr(9)
			Case Else
				strSubData = strSubData & strDat

Function fncInputCheck( strType As String, strData As String ) As Boolean
	Dim varResult As Variant
	Dim strDataPiece As String
	Dim strPiece As String
	Dim intSetNum As Integer
	fncInputCheck = False
	Select Case strType
	Case "!A"
		If Isnumeric(strData) = False Then
			fncInputCheck = False
		Elseif Clng(strData) <= 0 Then
			fncInputCheck = False
		Elseif Instr(strData, ".") > 0 Then
			fncInputCheck = False
		Else
			fncInputCheck = True
		End If
	Case "U","!C","!M"
		varResult = Split(strData, ";", -1, 5)
		If Ubound(varResult) = 1 Then
			fncInputCheck = True
		Else
			fncInputCheck = False
		End If
		Erase varResult
	Case "N","D"
		strDataPiece = strData
		Do While strDataPiece <> ""
			intSetNum = Instr(strDataPiece,";")
			Select Case intSetNum
			Case 0
				strPiece = strDataPiece
				strDataPiece = ""
			Case 1
				strPiece = "ERROR"
				strDataPiece = ""
			Case Else
				strPiece = Left( strDataPiece, intSetNum-1 )
				strDataPiece = Right( strDataPiece, Len(strDataPiece)-intSetNum )
				If strDataPiece = "" Then
					strPiece = "ERROR"
				End If
			End Select
			If (( strType = "N" ) And ( Isnumeric( strPiece ) = False ))_
			Or (( strType = "D" ) And ( Isdate( strPiece ) = False )) Then
				fncInputCheck = False
				Exit Do
			Else
				fncInputCheck = True
			End If
		Loop
	Case Else
		fncInputCheck = True
	End Select
End Function
